project.name: Marketing Toolbox internal product strategy
project.disclosure: This is a real internal product-planning run using repository and governance facts. It is not a customer case, willingness-to-pay test, domain review, or release approval.

strengths.statement: The repository has 144 tool pages, including 30 core tools arranged into six workflows.

weaknesses.statement: Six core tools have source-backed method bases and contract readiness; no core tool has fixture, reviewed, or release readiness.

opportunities.statement: The approved content architecture can connect WordPress problem and workflow pages to the independent toolbox without sharing project data.

threats.statement: A large page catalog may create maintenance cost without proving recurring user demand or willingness to pay.
threats.sourceGapReason: No authorized customer-use or willingness-to-pay sample exists; this risk is an internal planning inference.

strategy-toolkit/swot-analysis.html.prioritizedImplication: Stop expanding the catalog; prove one complete evidence-led workflow with authorized use before promoting readiness or building the next workflow.

x.label: Workflow continuity
x.direction: isolated page to linked project workflow

y.label: Evidence governance
y.direction: untracked claims to sourced reviewable evidence

alternatives.name: Existing isolated canvas pages
alternatives.sourceGapReason: Internal comparison archetype derived from the repository's pre-workflow page behavior; not a market-share claim.

alternatives.name: Generic whiteboard or spreadsheet templates
alternatives.sourceGapReason: Internal substitute hypothesis; named vendors and market positions have not been researched or reviewed.

strategy-toolkit/landscape-map.html.defensibleGap: A local-first workflow that retains provenance and explicit handoffs may be more reviewable than isolated templates, but customer preference and competitive differentiation remain unverified.

strategy-toolkit/business-model-canvas.h.customerSegment: Marketing consultants and small in-house marketing teams handling evidence-sensitive planning

valuePropositions: Turn fragmented planning canvases into a local, traceable and printable project workflow
relationships: Self-service use with optional reviewed project service

costStructure.basis: review and engineering hours per supported workflow

revenueStreams.basis: fixed scope per approved project; price not yet approved

contradictions: The current 144-page breadth conflicts with the decision to support only 30 core tools deeply.
strategy-toolkit/business-model-canvas.h.riskiestAssumption: The selected users will value provenance and workflow continuity enough to complete a multi-step planning process or purchase review support.

strategy-toolkit/value-proposition.html.customerSegment: Marketing consultants and small in-house marketing teams handling evidence-sensitive planning

jobs.statement: Turn research and assumptions into an owned marketing plan
Explain and review why a strategic conclusion was reached

pains.statement: Conclusions lose their sources when copied between isolated canvases
A large template library does not show which method to use next

gains.statement: A printable plan with explicit owners, sources, review dates and unresolved risks

responses.statement: Project-scoped evidence and explicit handoff adoption
Six ordered workflows with a supported core-tool tier
Reviewable local outputs without automatic project-data transmission

strategy-toolkit/value-proposition.html.chosenPromise: Move from a strategic question to a locally retained, sourced and reviewable plan without being forced into an account or cloud workspace.
strategy-toolkit/value-proposition.html.unresolvedMismatch: No authorized customer run proves that users can complete the six-step workflow or prefer it to their current templates.

strategy-toolkit/okr-cascade.html.customerSegment: Marketing consultants and small in-house marketing teams handling evidence-sensitive planning
strategy-toolkit/okr-cascade.html.objective: Make Strategy Alignment a credible, reviewable workflow before expanding the supported product surface.
strategy-toolkit/okr-cascade.html.strategyLink: Prove one evidence-led workflow with authorized use before promoting readiness or starting Workflow 02.
